$comment: Locator for every secret. Names and locations only: never put a value here. Verified by infra/gcp/tests/test_config_schema.py.

local-root-env.description: Ignored .env at the repository root (copy of .env.template). Read by Docker Compose interpolation and by Identity's local startup.

gcp-secret-manager.description: One dotenv payload per Secret Manager secret, named <name_prefix>-<payload>-env (default prefix: fantasybuilder). Terraform creates the containers only; versions are uploaded by hand.
gcp-secret-manager.update: gcloud secrets versions add <prefix>-<payload>-env --project=$PROJECT_ID --data-file=<file>, then deploy with fantasybuilder-deploy (hosts only read the latest version during a deployment).

gcp-host.description: Where the VM runs the active payloads: /etc/fantasybuilder/current/<payload>.env (root-only). Fetched by infra/gcp/templates/fetch-secrets.sh.

github-actions.description: Repository variables only (GCP_* and DEPLOY_URL, no application secrets). Application secrets never live in GitHub.

provider-console.description: Where a third-party credential is created or revoked. Not stored in this repository.

secrets.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
secrets.rotation: Changing the dotenv does not change existing PostgreSQL roles.

secrets.name: IDENTITY_DB_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Password of the fantasy_identity database role.
secrets.rotation: Changing the dotenv does not change existing PostgreSQL roles.

secrets.name: APP_DB_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Password of the fantasy_api role (fantasy_app database: scouting).
secrets.rotation: Changing the dotenv does not change existing PostgreSQL roles.

secrets.name: VAULT_DB_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Password of the fantasy_vault role used by Auth.
secrets.rotation: Changing the dotenv does not change existing PostgreSQL roles.

secrets.name: INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Service token for Auth's /internal/* routes (LaLiga bearer exchange).

secrets.name: SCOUTING_SERVICE_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Lets the scouting worker redeem its read grant at Auth.

secrets.name: AUTO_MARKET_SERVICE_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Lets the auto-market worker redeem its write delegation at Auth.
secrets.rotation: Must differ from INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN and SCOUTING_SERVICE_TOKEN.

secrets.name: SCRAPING_SERVICE_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Service token for the scraping service's /internal/scrape/* routes.

secrets.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
secrets.purpose: Better Auth signing/encryption secret for Identity.
secrets.rotation: Preserve it across releases and restarts; never rotate without a plan.

secrets.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Resend API key used by Identity to send verification and recovery mail.

origin.where: Resend dashboard > API Keys (domain fantasybuilder.es must be verified)

secrets.rotation: Local and production hold independent copies; revoking a key in Resend breaks every place that still uses it. Never commit it, including to .env.template.

secrets.name: TOKEN_VAULT_KEY_BASE64
secrets.purpose: AES-256 key that seals stored LaLiga connections in Auth's vault.
secrets.rotation: Changing it makes stored vault data unreadable. Coordinate any rotation separately.

secrets.name: OPENWEATHER_API_KEY
secrets.purpose: Optional weather provider for the calendar.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.purpose: Optional Google sign-in (set together with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID).
secrets.rotation: Omit unused provider keys entirely rather than setting them blank.

secrets.name: FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.purpose: Optional Facebook sign-in (set together with FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID).
secrets.rotation: Omit unused provider keys entirely rather than setting them blank.

secrets.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.purpose: Optional Apple sign-in key (with APPLE_CLIENT_ID, APPLE_TEAM_ID, APPLE_KEY_ID). PEM with literal \n.
secrets.rotation: Omit unused provider keys entirely rather than setting them blank.
